messages:
Riley M: Hey team — converted from contractor to full-time on 2024-11-02. Quick questions: 1) When will my health + dental kick in? 2) How is PTO prorated for Nov? 3) My company card shows 'not active' in Wallet. Who do I contact for each?

Tara (People Ops): Congrats Riley! Benefits typically start the 1st of the month after HR finalizes FT status. If HR confirmed before the benefits cutoff you might get 12/01. Please enroll at https://benefits.redwood.com and attach the HR conversion email for any retroactive requests.

Riley M: HR confirmation email was dated 11/03. If I enroll today will that still make 12/01?

Benefits Team: Enrollment before the 11/20 cutoff will usually make 12/01. Since your HR confirmation is 11/03 you should be within window — upload the email during enrollment so we can verify.

Payroll: PTO accrual changes on your official FT start date. For November we prorate by days active in month (FT days / 30). If you share your monthly accrual rate we can calculate the exact figure.

Riley M: Monthly accrual is 2.0 days.

Payroll: For Nov you'd get 2.0 * (29/30) = ~1.93 days (assuming FT status counted from 11/02 inclusive). We'll update your portal; check Payroll -> Time off in 24 hours.

Riley M: Card issue — Wallet shows 'activation failed: id mismatch' when I enter last4.

Card Support: Hi Riley — that error means the card record and HR profile info (DOB/last4) didn't match. Try re-entering with the last four on your physical card. If you don't have it yet we'll issue a virtual card immediately. Do you want a virtual one while we fix the physical?

Riley M: Virtual please, that'd be great. Also submitting HR email to benefits now. Thanks all! :tada:
